evidence.exact_quote: A restricted file-write or file-edit authorization policy must use roots that grant write permission and must not reuse read-only plugin-skill roots merely because their paths are contained.
evidence.supported_claim: Restricted write and edit authorization must separate write-permitted roots from read-only plugin-skill roots.

evidence.exact_quote: Untrusted outbound message content must neutralize platform broadcast mentions and must disable mention interpretation when the delivery API exposes such a companion capability.
evidence.supported_claim: Outbound delivery must neutralize broadcast mentions and disable mention interpretation where supported.

evidence.exact_quote: Browser evaluation that can change the main-frame location must validate the expression-derived or resulting destination against the same scheme, hostname, and IP policy required for direct navigation.
evidence.supported_claim: Browser evaluation navigation requires destination validation equivalent to direct navigation.

evidence.exact_quote: Model-controlled source code that is written and launched as a host process must pass a code-dependent action-approval decision before process creation.
evidence.supported_claim: Host code execution requires a code-dependent approval before process creation.

evidence.exact_quote: A dangerous-command gate must cover every source-supported destructive command class before auto-approval; an incomplete pattern table must not be treated as complete authorization.
evidence.supported_claim: Dangerous-command auto-approval requires complete source-supported pattern coverage.

evidence.exact_quote: A subagent type may be auto-approved as read-only only when the selected configuration's tool surface and permission mode are actually read-only and do not exceed the parent approval envelope.
evidence.supported_claim: Auto-approved subagent types require tool and permission capability congruence.

evidence.exact_quote: A blocking-device denylist must canonicalize user-controlled paths, including home expansion and dot-segment normalization, before comparing device identities.
evidence.supported_claim: Blocking-device checks require canonical path identity before denylist comparison.

evidence.exact_quote: A model-selected adb shell action must require explicit user approval or a deny-by-default command policy before execution; a non-empty command check alone is not authorization.
evidence.supported_claim: Model-selected adb shell actions require approval or deny-by-default command authorization.

evidence.exact_quote: A durable allow-always approval for a shell wrapper must bind the complete normalized inner payload and must not persist trust for only the wrapper executable path.
evidence.supported_claim: Durable shell-wrapper approvals must bind the normalized inner payload.

evidence.exact_quote: A jq safe-bin policy must reject jq programs that access the environment through `env` or `$ENV` before auto-approval.
evidence.supported_claim: jq safe-bin auto-approval must reject environment builtins.

evidence.exact_quote: A jq safe-bin policy must reject or safely resolve include and import module directives before jq is auto-approved for host execution.
evidence.supported_claim: jq safe-bin auto-approval must validate include and import directives.

evidence.exact_quote: Every route that emits Matrix custom HTML must neutralize raw HTML, event attributes, and dangerous URI schemes on the primary path, not only on an error fallback.
evidence.supported_claim: All primary Matrix custom-HTML routes require complete HTML and URI neutralization.

evidence.exact_quote: A noninteractive batch or scheduled execution context must fail closed or route model-controlled dangerous commands through an explicit approval policy instead of defaulting to approved.
evidence.supported_claim: Noninteractive dangerous-command routing must fail closed or use explicit approval.

evidence.exact_quote: After a browser click, double-click, or evaluated page action can navigate, the resulting destination must be revalidated before later browser access.
evidence.supported_claim: Browser interactions with navigation side effects require post-action destination validation.

evidence.exact_quote: Inline-command extraction must recognize every supported cmd and PowerShell wrapper flag spelling before allowlist or durable-approval evaluation.
evidence.supported_claim: Shell-wrapper inline-command extraction must normalize every supported flag spelling.

evidence.exact_quote: A restricted child-process environment must remove messaging and provider credential names from the inherited environment before launching model-controlled commands.
evidence.supported_claim: Restricted child environments must remove messaging and provider credentials.
